sources.snippet: Introduction Hojo-ASR-V1 is a high-performance conversational speech recognition model powered by the Qwen3 LLM decoder. It adopts the classic Encoder-Adapter-LLM framework with a customized multi-frame acoustic fusion architecture, fully leveraging acoustic fine-grained features and strong LLM semantic capabilities.
